answer: In a virtual restoration market, a haven commissions agents to reconstruct the echo of an onyx bell from damaged audio. Each job pays once for an accepted repair keyed to its source recording; bidders lock a bond that can be forfeited for copied work or missed deadlines. A Sybil operator cannot turn one cleaned track into many fees by opening accounts. To earn more, it must restore different recordings and fund more bonds. A wealthy cartel could still buy many slots or collude with reviewers, so blind comparison against held-out audio and an appeal process are needed.
